Perplexity can build Meta Quest 3 apps. Here’s an example of a mixed reality drone simulator

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-24T15:43:49+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2125254068813873390; média: videó, 58 másodperc]
We asked Perplexity to build a mixed-reality FPV drone simulator.

One of our users demoed it on Meta Quest 3 in his living room. The app shows a simulated Tiny Whoop flying around the space, bouncing off surfaces like walls and furniture based on a room scan that Perplexity ran.

Perplexity built this app in Unity with a custom Blender model. It supports Quest controllers or a USB-connected RadioMaster Pocket.
